scope: Independent CPU-only recount of immutable R03 native annotations, tile geometry, YOLO labels, and installed detection-loss source. No training, prediction, GPU, raw data edits, remote writes, or physical-camera claims.

exposure_concentration.interpretation: Label-exposure share is not the same as image sampling probability or loss weight. Uniform tile sampling means tile fraction is nominal sample share; actual gradient contribution depends on assignments and loss normalization.

interpretation.fragment_rule: Any positive integer overlap, including width or height 1 px, is a positive target label. Counts alone do not establish that this rule caused low confidence or lower AP; controlled retraining is required.
interpretation.entire_object_statement: No full bbox present in any saved training crop means no complete bbox context from those crops. It does not prove no visually complete silhouette if the source box includes background, nor exclude prior pretrained exposure. Subsequent augmentation can truncate further.
interpretation.known_non_target_objects: Excluding verified non-target types is normal for a four-class closed-set detector; non-target detections should count as false positives. Making all known non-targets ignore is not automatically an improvement and can reduce suppression. Ontology overlap such as pins versus connector needs explicit review.
interpretation.unknown_objects: Unknown boxes may conceal target types; treating these as negative may create false-negative supervision. Preserve unknown and review; do not invent target class.

loss_code_evidence.finding: Unmapped objects not written as labels; intersecting target pieces are retained; there is no ignore field.
Standard YOLO training; no custom ignore criterion.
Targets are batch_idx, cls, bboxes; BCE computed across all anchors and classes then summed, without an ignore-area mask.
Unassigned anchors have zero target scores and remain part of the BCE sum.

interpretation.gray_fill_consequence: Filling pixels with gray and removing their labels is train-time visual erasure/negative background, not ignored classification loss. It may also cover adjacent valid targets, introduce artificial edges, or make an easy background domain. Any ablation must use this accurate name.
interpretation.real_ignore_requirement: A real detector ignore path needs spatial ignore metadata that survives geometric augmentation and anchor/assignment masks that suppress negative class-loss contributions inside ignored regions, with explicit positive-target precedence, plus separate evaluation ignore policy. Verify gradients on synthetic examples before training.
interpretation.other_class_requirement: A fifth class changes ontology, model head, label mapping, and metrics. Known source types may be candidates, but heterogeneous text/pads/unknown must not be automatically pooled as a semantic other-component truth.

not_evaluated: Performance effect of changing fragments or ignored regions
Any new model or threshold performance
